phase: Exploratory diagnostics after seeing primary estimates; not a preregistration

bootstrap.method: paired circular blocks, all cells jointly; original weights and geographic grids fixed; quarterly blocks 4/2 observations

analyses.name: Product, destination, and cell risk attributions
analyses.scope: Product estimates and intervals for every available prespecified case; destination/cell intervals for both countries in primary case
analyses.additivity: Exact symmetric allocation of each quadratic-form change, averaged over the original two orders

analyses.name: Memory share versus composition within non-memory
analyses.scope: Both countries and all prespecified cases, retaining unavailable cases
analyses.method: At each of initial/final geography, split the product change symmetrically into memory share and non-memory proportions, then average; components add to original product Shapley contribution
analyses.meaning: Descriptive grouped attribution, not an intervention or a new method

analyses.name: Covariance-window bridge
analyses.scope: Both countries; 2018-2020 and 2021-2024, common primary weights and grid
analyses.method: Exact within-window covariance plus between-window mean covariance identity

analyses.name: Leave one calendar year out
analyses.scope: Both countries; every year 2018-2024; fixed primary weights and grid
analyses.method: Recalculate covariance and all original contributions; not independent replications

analyses.name: Ordinary-growth denominator diagnostics
analyses.scope: Both countries; undefined observations kept undefined; extreme observations shown
analyses.method: No winsorization, dropping small flows, or changing the main symmetric-growth specification

analyses.name: Result-specific novelty check
analyses.scope: Primary literature and closest official semiconductor studies; targeted search, not exhaustive review

restrictions: Do not select a period, grid or growth measure by desired sign
Do not reinterpret nominal FOB flows as physical quantities or exogenous demand
Do not equate a customs destination with final demand or resolve Other Asia, nes to Taiwan automatically
Exploratory percentile intervals are pointwise and not adjusted for multiple comparisons
No manuscript, supervisor DOCX, or Growth-at-Risk changes
